description: Centered bounding-box rotation and 3D footprint unit selection fail ordinary geometric assertions when mutated.

mutants.test_filter: Bounding boxes rotate around an explicit center
mutants.description: The asymmetric non-origin quarter-turn checks both returned bounds, so rotating a corner around the origin instead of the requested center changes the result.

mutants.test_filter: 3D bounding boxes merge point clouds and expose xy footprints in both units
mutants.description: The raw and scaled footprint expectations distinguish the documented unit choice for each public polygon(bool) mode.
